provenance.encodes: The Indigo Book, R18.1 (Rules of Evidence and Procedure)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Indigo Book (https://law.resource.org/pub/us/code/blue/IndigoBook.html, CC0), R18.1 (Rules of Evidence and Procedure), and compare the form and examples with this pattern.

positive.text: Competency is governed by Unif. R. Evid. 601.
Business records come in under Unif. R. Evid. 803(6).
Compare Unif. R. Evid. 702 with Unif. R. Evid. 1001.

negative: The Unif. R. Evid. drafters met in 1953.
Uniform rules of evidence 601 and 602 differ.
Rule 601 of the uniform rules is short.
